name: Breaking-change detection
description: Find consumers of APIs that look removed or renamed. Refine selectors after Plan diffs the public surface.

selectors.description: ESM/CJS imports — refine pattern to the package under change
Replace DEPRECATED_API with symbols removed in the release

mapGuidance: For each signal, decide whether the call site breaks given the API diff in the profile notes / PR description. Classify compile-break vs behavioral break. Name the owning package.
reduceGuidance: Group call sites under the API change that caused them. Produce one migration plan per breaking change with ordered steps and owners.
verifyGuidance: Run typecheck/tests for affected packages. Confirmed = still fails. False positive = compiles/tests green.
